description: Checks a draft's `responseRedactions` and `responseMatches` against the captured response, offline, with the attestor's own redaction and match engine. No network call. Returns `ok`, `failedAt` and `reason` on failure, `extractedParameters`, and the `revealed` body slices the attestor would see (truncated). Pass `responseMatches`, `responseRedactions`, or `paramValues` to try an edit without saving it, and `requestId` to check against a different captured request. Run it before `run_proof`.

requestId.description: Captured request whose response to check. Defaults to the request the draft was proposed from.

isOptional.description: Verification still passes when this match is absent.

name: check_matchers
